headline: Submitted, awaiting Amazon. Amazon has the submission and has not yet said what became of it — processing happens afterwards, and a listing can still fail then with the reason attached to the SKU.
nextAction: Check what became of it: GET /api/amazon/listing-state?sku=ING-NERDQAXE-001. Until that reports Amazon's own status for the SKU, the only true statement is that Amazon has it.
